components.note: 钅 (metal) — 钅 is the simplified 金 (metal), as in 铁, 银, 钟; early money was metal coins.
戋 (jiān) — near sound — 钱 is qián; 戋 also sounds out 浅 qiǎn and 线 xiàn, and means small or thin.
讠 (speech) — 讠 is the simplified 言 (speech), as in 说, 话, 请; 诚 is honest speech.
成 (chéng) — same sound — 诚 is chéng, like 成; 成 also sounds out 城 chéng.
贝 (shell, money) — 贝 is money and value, as in 财, 买, 贵; 贱 is cheap and low in value.
戋 (jiān) — near sound — 贱 is jiàn; 戋 also hints small, as in 钱 and 浅.
米 (rice, grain) — 米 is rice and grain, as in 粥, 糖, 精; 粉 is flour ground from grain, then powder.
分 (fēn) — same sound, different tone — 粉 is fěn; 分 also sounds out 份 fèn.
纟 (silk, thread) — 纟 is the simplified 糸 (silk); 丝 is the simplified form of 絲, two skeins of silk side by side.
厂 (cliff, shelter) — 厂 is a cliff or overhang and the root of 厅, 原, 厚; the modern meaning "factory" is separate, as in 工厂.
殳 (strike) — 殳 is a hand with a tool striking, as in 毁, 殴; 段 is a piece cut off a larger whole, and sounds out 锻 duàn.
农 (farming) — simplified from 農, which showed a tool 辰 working a field 田; 农 is farming, as in 农民.
网 (net) — a picture of a hanging net with crossing cords; as a radical it appears as 罒 in 罚, 置, 罗.
毛 (hair) — a picture of a tuft of hair or fur; used in 毛巾 and 毛病 (a flaw).
氵 (water) — 氵 is water, as in 河, 海, 汤; 流 is flowing water.
㐬 (liú) — same sound — 流 is liú; 㐬 also sounds out 琉 liú and 硫 liú.
讠 (speech) — 讠 is the simplified 言 (speech), as in 说, 话; 辩 puts two 辛 (offenders) with words between them, an argument.
女 (woman) — 女 marks women and feelings in old forms, as in 妒, 嫉; 嫌 is to dislike.
兼 (jiān) — near sound — 嫌 is xián; 兼 also sounds out 谦 qiān and 歉 qiàn.
木 (tree) — 木 is tree, as in 桃, 林, 树; 李 is the plum tree.
子 (zǐ) — near sound — 李 is lǐ; 子 also sounds out 仔 zǐ.
王 (jade) — 王 on the left is 玉 (jade), as in 球, 现; 玛瑙 is agate.
马 (mǎ) — same sound — 玛 is mǎ, like 马.
宀 (roof) — 宀 is a roof, as in 家, 室, 安; 宁 is peace and calm at home.
丁 (dīng) — near sound — 宁 is níng; 丁 also sounds out 订 dìng and 厅 tīng.
目 (eye) — 目 is the eye, as in 看, 眼, 睛; 瞒 is hiding something from sight.
㒼 (mán) — same sound — 瞒 is mán; 㒼 also sounds out 满 mǎn.
心 (heart) — 心 marks feelings, as in 想, 爱, 怒; 悲 is sorrow.
非 (fēi) — near sound — 悲 is bēi; 非 also sounds out 辈 bèi and 排 pái.
小 (small) — 小 above 大 — a small top over a big base is a point.
齿 (teeth) — 齿 is the tooth radical — age was read from teeth, as in 年龄.
令 (lìng) — near sound — 龄 is líng; 令 also sounds out 领 lǐng and 铃 líng.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 换 is to swap with the hands.
奂 (huàn) — same sound — 换 is huàn, like 奂; 奂 also sounds out 唤 huàn.
⺮ (bamboo) — ⺮ is bamboo, as in 笔, 筷, 箱; tallies were bamboo slips split in two to match, so 符 is to match.
付 (fù) — near sound — 符 is fú; 付 also sounds out 附 fù and 府 fǔ.
马 (horse) — 马 is the horse radical, as in 骗, 驾, 验; 骑 is to ride.
奇 (qí) — same sound — 骑 is qí, like 奇; 奇 also sounds out 椅 yǐ.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water, as in 河, 海; 洗 is to wash.
先 (xiān) — near sound — 洗 is xǐ; 先 also sounds out 选 xuǎn.
口 (mouth) — 口 is a mouth, as in 吃, 叫, 吗; 哈 is the sound of laughing.
合 (hé) — near sound — 哈 is hā; 合 also sounds out 盒 hé.
钅 (metal) — 钅 is the simplified 金 (metal), as in 钱, 铁; 针 is a metal needle.
十 (ten, cross) — 十 stands for the needle's shape, as in the old form 針.
页 (head) — 页 is the head, as in 题, 顶, 颜; 领 is the neck and then to lead.
令 (lìng) — near sound — 领 is lǐng; 令 also sounds out 龄 líng and 铃 líng.
廾 (two hands) — two hands joined — 共 is doing together; it also sounds out 供 gōng.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water, as in 洗, 海; 澡 is bathing.
喿 (zào) — same sound — 澡 is zǎo; 喿 also sounds out 燥 zào and 操 cāo.
禾 (grain) — 禾 is grain, as in 种, 秋; 稍 first meant the tip of the grain, a little bit.
肖 (xiāo) — near sound — 稍 is shāo; 肖 also sounds out 消 xiāo and 削 xiāo.
饣 (food) — 饣 is the simplified 食 (food), as in 饭, 饿, 饼; 饮 is a drink.
欠 (open mouth) — 欠 shows a person with an open mouth — taking a drink.
皿 (dish) — 皿 is a vessel, as in 盘, 盒; 盗 is coveting what is not yours.
次 (drool) — 次 here originally pictured drooling — wanting something greedily.
土 (earth) — 土 is earth, as in 地, 城; 增 is piling earth higher, then increasing.
曾 (céng) — near sound — 增 is zēng; 曾 also sounds out 赠 zèng and 憎 zēng.
牙 (tooth) — a picture of interlocking teeth; 牙 also sounds out 芽 yá and 讶 yà.
止 (zhǐ) — near sound — 齿 is chǐ; the lower part pictures teeth in a mouth, and 齿 is the tooth radical.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water, as in 河, 海; 渴 is thirst, a need for water.
曷 (hé) — near sound — 渴 is kě; 曷 also sounds out 喝 hē.
马 (horse) — 马 is the horse radical, as in 骑, 驶; 驾 is to harness a horse, then drive.
加 (jiā) — same sound, different tone — 驾 is jià; 加 also sounds out 架 jià.
马 (horse) — 马 is the horse radical, as in 骑, 驾; 驶 is to drive swiftly.
史 (shǐ) — same sound — 驶 is shǐ, like 史.
殳 (strike) — 殳 is a hand striking with a tool, as in 殴, 段; 毁 is to wreck.
火 (fire) — 火 is fire, as in 烧, 灯, 炒; 灭 covers a fire with a stroke 一 to put it out.
讠 (speech) — 讠 is the simplified 言 (speech), as in 说, 话; 诅 is a spoken curse.
且 (qiě) — near sound — 诅 is zǔ; 且 also sounds out 祖 zǔ and 组 zǔ.
口 (mouth) — 口 is a mouth, as in 吃, 叫; 咒 is a curse spoken aloud.
口 (mouth) — words passed down through ten 十 generations of mouths — old; 古 also sounds out 姑 gū and 故 gù.
贝 (shell, money) — 贝 is money, as in 买, 费, 贵; 财 is wealth.
才 (cái) — same sound — 财 is cái, like 才; 才 also sounds out 材 cái.
辛 (bitter) — 辛 pictures a sharp tool once used to mark offenders; it means bitter and laborious, as in 辛苦, and is part of 辣 and 辞.
水 (water) — a picture of flowing water; as a radical it appears as 氵 on the left (海, 河) or 水 at the bottom (泉, 冰).
土 (earth) — 土 is earth, as in 地, 城; a mold was made of clay, so 型 is a model or type.
刑 (xíng) — same sound — 型 is xíng, like 刑.
口 (mouth) — 口 is a mouth, as in 吃, 叫, 吗; 吵 is noisy speech.
少 (shǎo) — near sound — 吵 is chǎo; 少 also sounds out 炒 chǎo and 抄 chāo.
